Author: Jacob5800
Name: Portrait Atelier
Description: Create and apply curated portrait designs from your own character in one click.
Punchline: Make and apply a portrait in one click.
Changelog:
### 0.1.4.0
- Updated compatibility for FFXIV patch 7.57.

### 0.1.3.0
- Added one-click portrait styling with curated looks and generated variations.
- Added options to use unlocked poses and expressions and owned backgrounds, frames, and decorations, while keeping the current character or banner design when desired.
- Improved validation and application of changes in the in-game editor.

Author: Jacob5800
Name: Retainer Pricer
Punchline: Price listings and manage retainer ventures.
Description: Price eligible retainer listings with Universalis and a configurable match or one-gil-undercut rule. Manage retainer ventures using the game's own retainer UI.
Changelog:
### 0.5.0.14

- Added Backup / export settings in Settings. Export pricing, Sniper, venture settings and all item lists to a JSON file. Market caches and retainer listing snapshots are excluded; venture assignments retain their retainer IDs.
- Preview a backup before importing, then merge lists or replace included settings. Merge adds missing list/dictionary entries while preserving existing entries; included scalar settings are applied. A timestamped backup of your previous settings is saved beside the imported file first. Stop active operations and watching before import.

Author: Neko Boi Nick
Name: Housing Timeout Reminder
Description: A plugin to remind you about your house on FFXIV just in case you forgot to visit it.
Punchline: Remind you to visit your house just in case you forgot.
Changelog:
## 1.0.5.4

- Added an opt-in HT server-bar button. Click it to open settings; its tooltip shows the next enabled house needing a visit. Optional yellow/red colors indicate your reminder interval, not the game's demolition timer.
- Added an Echo confirmation when an interior visit is recorded, with a settings toggle.
- Added export and merge import of tracked characters, house addresses and visit dates. Import preserves newer matching-address visits and existing conflicting addresses. Backups are saved in this user's plugin configuration folder.
- Renamed Reset Warnings to Show dismissed reminders again. It restores dismissed reminders without resetting recorded visits.

Author: Jacob5800
Name: Workshoppa
Description: Dalamud API 15 continuation of Workshoppa. Automates workshop material turn-ins, offers retainer deposits with item exclusions, and can skip cutscenes between production phases.
Changelog:
## 9.3.13.1

- Retainer Deposit now opens manually by default. Enable Automatically open Retainer Deposit in settings to restore automatic opening.
- Added Add all inventory items to keep list, with clear text that those item types (HQ and NQ) will not be deposited. Refreshing the picker remains separate.
- Added settings export/import for the keep list, presets, queued projects and calculator settings. Import merges the keep list, replaces presets/queue/settings and saves a safety backup first. Live crafting progress is excluded.
- The Discord join button now uses a recognizable Discord-style symbol. Added a workshop-themed plugin icon.
